The STP6N62K3 is an N-channel Power MOSFET manufactured by STMicroelectronics.

Key Specifications & Features

• Type: N-channel Power MOSFET
• Technology: MDmesh K3 / SuperMESH3™
• Drain-Source Voltage (\(V_{DSS}\)): 620 V
• Continuous Drain Current (\(I_{D}\)): 5.5 A (at \(T_{c}\))
• On-Resistance (\(R_{DS(on)}\)): ~0.95 Ω (typical)
• Dissipated Power (\(P_{t}\)): 90 W (at \(T_{c}\))
• Package Type: Through-hole TO-220
• Pinout (TO-220): Pin 1 = Gate (G), Pin 2 = Drain (D) / Tab, Pin 3 = Source (S)
